text:
ciara: Strange production hit today. Customer doing large multipart streaming uploads hit a 429 on part #7 and our Go SDK retried but ended up creating a second upload record. Possible missing idempotency on resume.

marta: Ack. Which SDK versions?

ciara: Go 0.8.2 and Node 1.3.5. Node seemed fine in our quick check, Go resume path doesn't attach the original Idempotency-Key header.

hao: Can you drop the relevant request/response log?

ciara: Pasted logs: ```
2026-04-02T09:12:01Z INFO part_upload id=up-511 part=6 status=200
2026-04-02T09:12:03Z WARN recv 429 TooManyRequests part=7
2026-04-02T09:12:03Z INFO retry attempt=1 resume_token=tok-7 headers={}
2026-04-02T09:12:04Z INFO new_upload created id=up-512 reason=missing_idempotency
```

alex: Oof. We should treat multipart streams like a single logical operation and preserve the same op id across resumes.

marta: Proposed small change: when starting an upload, if user supplies `Idempotency-Key` or `X-Op-Id`, stash it in the stream object and reapply to resume requests. I'll submit a patch.

hao: Also let's standardize retry strategy across SDKs. My recommendation: full-jitter exp backoff with a configurable cap and an optional circuit-breaker for repeated 429s. Example backoff: ```js
// full jitter
function backoff(attempt, base=150, cap=12000){
  const max = Math.min(cap, base * (1<<attempt));
  return Math.floor(Math.random() * max);
}
```

alex: +1. For non-idempotent endpoints default to only 1 auto-retry and then call user callback. Add client config: `allow_auto_replay_for_non_idempotent: false` and `max_auto_retries: 1` for safety.

marta: Will add a config flag and keep default conservative. We should avoid surprises for customers.

ciara: Also need a tiny sample-app e2e that simulates a 429 in the middle of an upload and asserts no duplicates. Sam/QA can run against the canary.

hao: For Go patch snippet I suggest something like: ```go
// ensure opID preserved on resume
if stream.OpID != "" {
  req.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", stream.OpID)
}
```

alex: Nice. We'll mirror the same behavior in Node/Python to keep parity. Add a unit test that introspects outgoing headers.

replay-bot: [automated] created issue DEX-4380: "Go SDK: multipart resume drops idempotency header -> duplicate uploads" assigned to marta

marta: I'll own the Go change and the unit tests. ETA tomorrow morning. Will also open a PR with the config flag.

ciara: Thanks. After PR I'll run the sample-app canary against the affected customer workspace before wider rollout.

alex: One more suggestion: document best practices in the SDK readmes: show how to generate stable Idempotency-Key per logical upload (UUID v4 per operation) and how to handle the user callback when automatic replay is suspended. Quick snippet for clients: ```js
const idKey = crypto.randomUUID();
client.uploadStream({ idempotencyKey: idKey }, stream);
```

hao: Good. Also add a short FAQ entry: "Why did I see duplicates?" explaining 429 mid-stream + missing key.

ciara: Perfect. Linking customer case and closing thread after canary passes. :white_check_mark:
